subject: Approval needed: Q1 runtime hiring tranche (kernel perf, SRE, compiler)
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Approval needed: Q1 runtime hiring tranche (kernel perf, SRE, compiler)

Team —

Requesting approval to open three prioritized runtime/infra reqs for Q1 ramp. Summary below; full package attached (Q1_runtime_hire_summary.pdf) and I also linked the hiring plan doc. TL;DR: we need immediate increases to hit our latency SLOs and support Dedicated customer ramp.

Open reqs (headcount + rationale):
- Kernel Performance Engineer (IC4) — focus on attention/kernel optimization, 20% expected reduction in median token latency for customer workloads; critical to reduce cost-per-token for high-throughput customers.
- Inference SRE Lead (IC5) — lead on autoscaling, preemptible/pool management, oncall runbooks and incident reduction; will own SLA playbook for Dedicated pools.
- Runtime Compiler SWE (IC4) — compiler-level work for quantized paths and kernel selection; short-term deliverable: 4 quantized backends by EOY.

Comp bands we propose (ranges are base + target eq):
- IC4: $165k–$195k base + 0.08–0.12% eq
- IC5: $215k–$255k base + 0.20–0.30% eq

Budget ask: 3 net-new FTEs, funding to come from the infra hiring tranche (we recommend using the Q1 reserved bucket and reallocating two non-priority open slots from the analytics hiring slate). This keeps net headcount neutral to the org plan while redirecting capacity to runtime.

External recruiting partners: Harris Recruiting (lead) and Prospect Labs (overflow). I asked recruiting to prep job specs and candidate pipeline; greenhouse reqs are created in draft.

Action requested: please confirm approval to convert the drafts to active reqs and allow recruiter offers up to the top of the band for IC4 and up to 10% above midpoint for IC5 if candidate meets critical skillset. If approved, I'll circulate interview panels and target offers by Feb 14.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Lead, Runtime Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Feb 2028 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval needed: Q1 runtime hiring tranche (kernel perf, SRE, compiler)

Thanks Mateo — good write-up. A couple of clarifying questions before I greenlight: 

1) Can you attach the role-specific comp band sheet (breakout for base / bonus / equity) and the expected on-target compensation (OTC) for both IC4 and IC5? We need the full OTC numbers for finance sign-off.
2) Are any of these 3 roles backfills or net-new? You mentioned reallocating 2 slots from analytics — please identify the exact req ids so we can track org transfers.
3) What is the expected timeline from open to offer accept? If we're pushing for Feb 14 offers, ensure recruiting confirms interview availability — otherwise we should shift the timeline.

Also, given the potential to pay up to 10% above midpoint for IC5, I want Marcus to model the FY28 budget impact (run-rate + equity vesting) before final approval. Marcus — can you take this on?

On Wed, Feb 1, 2028 at 09:12, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Requesting approval to open three prioritized runtime/infra reqs for Q1 ramp...
> (truncated)

Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Feb 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval needed: Q1 runtime hiring tranche (kernel perf, SRE, compiler)

Appreciate the concise ask. I am supportive of prioritizing runtime hires given the Dedicated ramp and the measurable infra ROI you flagged. Conditional approvals below: 

- Approve 3 reqs to become active, conditional on: 
  * Marcus confirming that the FY28 run-rate fits within the current infra hiring envelope (Marcus, please share updated run-rate + headcount plan).
  * Compensation bands documented in an attachment to the reqs (we need the full base/OTC and equity carve-outs).
  * Recruiting confirms a pipeline target of 6 screened candidates per role within 4 weeks.

- Please route final offer approvals through the standard hiring committee for IC5 (I will expedite review once Marcus signs off).

If those conditions are met I want recruiters to start scheduling loop interviews and behavioral screens immediately. Mateo — I'm giving you a go-ahead to work with Harris Recruiting to convert the drafts to active Greenhouse reqs and kick off outreach. Aim to have a first slate by Feb 10.

Marissa Cole
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Feb 2028 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval needed: Q1 runtime hiring tranche (kernel perf, SRE, compiler) — attachments and next steps

Thanks — attaching the materials requested. Attachments: Q1_runtime_hire_summary.pdf, kernel_role_bands.xlsx, greenhouse-reqs-export.csv. The Greenhouse draft req IDs are INF-1241 / INF-1242 / INF-1243 (draft).

Quick answers inline: 
- All three are net-new FTEs; the two analytics slots I referenced are reqs we are pausing (AN-341 & AN-342) which recruiting confirmed can be repurposed in the org plan. I'll update the org tracker.
- Target timeline: open reqs this week, screens scheduled wk of Feb 6, on-site/loop wk of Feb 13, offers by Feb 14–16. Recruiting flagged 8–10 initial candidates from Harris.
- OTC estimates: IC4 ~ $210k total comp (midpoint), IC5 ~ $300k total comp (midpoint) — full breakdown in kernel_role_bands.xlsx.

Next steps I will take today: convert drafts to active reqs, share interview rubric, and provide recruiting with an offer ceiling per role. Marcus — please share the run-rate analysis when you have it; asking for final sign-off by EOD Feb 6 so we don't miss the hiring window.

Attachments (placeholders):
- Q1_runtime_hire_summary.pdf (summary deck, 3 slides)
- kernel_role_bands.xlsx (band breakouts, OTC math)
- greenhouse-reqs-export.csv (draft req export)

Thanks all —
Mateo Alvarez
Lead, Runtime Platform
Redwood Inference
